products.name: Korean Moon Light Night Cream
products.subtitle: Korean Moon Light Night Cream is a luxurious overnight skincare formula designed to deeply nourish, repair, and rejuvenate your skin while you sleep. Inspired by Korean skincare rituals, it helps improve skin texture, restore moisture balance, and promote a smooth, radiant complexion. Its lightweight yet rich formula absorbs easily, working overnight to reduce dullness and dryness, leaving your skin soft, refreshed, and glowing in the morning. Suitable for daily night use and all skin types.

products.name: Hydromist Moisturizing Spray
products.subtitle: Hydromist Moisturizing Spray is a lightweight, refreshing hydration mist designed to instantly replenish moisture and revive tired, dull skin. Its fast-absorbing formula helps soothe dryness, improve skin comfort, and leave a soft, dewy finish without stickiness. Perfect for use anytime during the day, before makeup, or after cleansing, it keeps your skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and energized. Suitable for all skin types.
